snippet.title: Painkiller - Pre-order Trailer
snippet.description:
Eternity is a lot of time to kill. Good thing you’ve got company.

Enter the gates of Purgatory on October 9, 2025. Available for pre-order now on Steam, PlayStation Store, and Xbox Store: saber.games/painkiller/
 
Pre-orders will receive the exclusive Iron Crusade character & weapon skins pack.

#Painkiller2025 #CoopShooter #UpcomingGames
